messages.author: e13072fd07a5d80a
messages.subject: Questions
parts:
I have a couple questions regarding your new authentications system.  Is it possible to add users to the app without myself manually adding their email in the shinyapps dashboard?  Is it possible, or are the plans to allow customization of the authorization screen?  

Thanks again,
Josh

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Questions
parts:
Hi Josh,

On your first question, we will be supporting a way of adding users through an R package.  Does that meet your need?

Regarding customization, we just received that request last week, it would be great to hear about what type of customization you would want for the authorization screen.  Would including your logo be sufficient for a first cut at it?

Best,
Tareef

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Questions

Tareef,

1. I'm not sure understand how that would work.  Would it be similar to the old addAuthorizedUser() function, but without needing to redeploy?  For now, this would probably be sufficient for me.  

2. A logo would be great.  The main thing I would like to change is the "Not Authorized" text.  It would be nice to customize that text.  It would also be nice to add a link to redirect them to where they can submit into to sign up for the app.

Thanks, I really appreciate everything you guys are doing!
Josh
